h: Natasha Osawaru shares a video of Peter Obi, drawing reactions ahead of 2027
p: Edo lawmaker and 2Baba's wife Natasha Osawaru reportedly posted a video of Peter Obi, the NDC presidential candidate, and it has drawn mixed reactions online. She earlier backed Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso at the NDC convention and has since won the party's ticket for her state assembly seat.
more: She is set to contest the Egor seat in 2027.
Supporters of other parties have also joined the online debate.
